title_en: Chinese Humor (6/20): The Parking Space Saga
note_en: 只要A，就B means "as long as A, then B": A alone is enough to bring about B. 只要晚回家十分钟，就很可能找不到车位 "come home just ten minutes late and you probably won't find a spot"; 只要大家把话说清楚，矛盾很快就能解决 "as long as people talk it through, conflicts are resolved quickly." English often drops the "then," but Chinese keeps 就 before the verb of the second clause.
